source: Nexon, 'Maplayer One Challenger World and Burning Events!' (news id 47305, 11 Nov 2026): Leveling Missions, Boss Missions, Seasonal Mission, Challenger World Tier, Rewards, Buffs, and Arcane Seal. Read 27 Nov 2026. Every number in this file is from that notice; the Arcane Seal part matches the v.272 patch notes (news id 47132).
claimNote: Rewards can be claimed until 10 Feb 2027 08:59 KST. Bronze to Platinum rewards only inside Challenger World; Emerald and up also in your main world via the Event List.
levelNote: Level missions complete by themselves when the level is reached (Challenger World window).
bossRules: Defeating a boss in Practice Mode will count toward the mission.
Defeats will only count when solo or in a solo party.
Defeating a higher difficulty version of a boss will count as completing the mission for the highest listed difficulty for that boss. Example: Extreme Lotus counts as the Hard Lotus mission.
higherUnknown: Nexon's notice does not say whether a clear of a listed difficulty (Hard Lucid) also completes the easier listed missions of that boss (Easy and Normal Lucid).
